# Blender.fi

> > A Finnish Blender community site featuring tutorials, artist showcases, release announcements, and workflow guides for 3D artists using Blender, Cycles, EEVEE, and related technologies.

Blender.fi aggregates content from the Blender community including video tutorials, migration guides from Maya/3ds Max, technical documentation, and artist portfolios. The site covers both stable releases (Blender 2.79) and cutting-edge development (Blender 2.8 with EEVEE engine).

## Key Topics

- Blender 2.8 and EEVEE realtime engine
- Blender 2.79 stable release
- Cycles rendering engine
- Maya to Blender migration
- 3ds Max to Blender workflow
- Alembic pipeline integration
- Boolean modifiers and modeling
- Node grouping and shading
- Grease Pencil animation
- Architectural visualization
- Blend4Web interactive 3D
- Video tutorials and live recordings
- BlenderNation community
- Spanish-language Blender content

## Blender Release News & Development

- [Blender 2.8 Design Document](https://blender.fi/2017/10/07/blender-2-8-design-document): Dalai Felinto's technical design document for Blender 2.8 development
- [Blender 2.8 EEVEE is Awesome!](https://blender.fi/2017/07/27/blender-2-8-eevee-is-awesome): Zacharias Reinhardt's demo of EEVEE realtime engine in Blender 2.8
- [Blender 2.79 Release Candidate 1](https://blender.fi/2017/08/07/blender-2-79-release-candidate-1): Blender 2.79 RC1 release announcement for testing and bug reporting

## Migration Guides & Pipeline Workflows

- [Alembic Pipeline: Bring your Maya animations to Blender for rendering in Cycles](https://blender.fi/2017/08/13/alembic-pipeline-bring-your-maya-animations-to-blender-for-rendering-in-cycles): PepeSchool tutorial on Alembic pipeline for Maya to Cycles workflow
- [Introduction to Blender from 3dsmax/Maya – Live recording #3 [Spanish]](https://blender.fi/2017/10/08/introduction-to-blender-from-3dsmaxmaya-live-recording-3-spanish): Juan Gea's Spanish live recording on migrating from 3ds Max/Maya to Blender

## Tutorials & Workflow Tips

- [3 Tips for Grouping Nodes in Blender](https://blender.fi/2017/10/13/3-tips-for-grouping-nodes-in-blender): Joey Bennett's workflow tips for node grouping in Blender
- [New video by Chris' Tutorials on YouTube](https://blender.fi/2017/08/22/new-video-by-chris-tutorials-on-youtube-10): Chris' Tutorials YouTube video on Boolean Modifier in Blender
- [Video: Wandering](https://blender.fi/2017/09/11/video-wandering): Chris Keegan's audio sync animation tutorial using Bake to F-Curve
- [Creation of a Modern Interior in Blender 2.79](https://blender.fi/2017/09/27/creation-of-a-modern-interior-in-blender-2-79): Pietro Chiovaro's architectural visualization workflow in Blender 2.79

## Artist Showcases & Projects

- [Interactive Car Configurator SWITCH](https://blender.fi/2017/09/14/interactive-car-configurator-switch): Standalone Complex's SWITCH interactive car configurator project showcase
- [The Art of Matias Martin](https://blender.fi/2017/09/04/the-art-of-matias-martin): Artist showcase featuring Matias Martin's retro-style 3D art from Argentina
- [New video by Blend4Web on YouTube](https://blender.fi/2017/08/22/new-video-by-blend4web-on-youtube-2): Blend4Web 17.08 release featuring Date & Time Node tutorial
